200.title: Polish president presents Erdogan with sword after NATO revolver gift
200.summary: Polish President Karol Nawrocki presented Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan with a sword during their meeting in New York, months after Erdogan gave him and other leaders custom-engraved revolvers at the NATO summit in Ankara.
200.body: Polish President Karol Nawrocki presented Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan with a sword during their meeting in New York, months after Erdogan gave him and other leaders custom-engraved revolvers at the NATO summit in Ankara. Erdogan, Nawrocki discuss bilateral ties During their closed-door meeting, Erdogan and Nawrocki discussed relations between Türkiye and Poland as well as regional and global developments, according to Türkiye’s Communications Directorate. Türkiye, Poland target $15B in trade Türkiye supported Poland’s accession to NATO in 1999, while Poland has backed Türkiye’s EU accession process. Polish exports to Türkiye totaled $6.03 billion last year, while Turkish exports to Poland stood at $6.48 billion, resulting in a $450 million trade surplus in Türkiye’s favor.

400.body: Envision Energy Advances Southeastern Europe's Wind Market as North Macedonia's Largest Wind Project Reaches Financial Close USA - English USA - English News provided by Envision Energy Sep 23, 2026, 04:13 ET Share this article Share to X Share this article Share to X ŠTIP, North Macedonia , Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Envision Energy, a global leader in green technology, is advancing wind development in Southeastern Europe as the 131.25 MW first phase of the Štip Wind Farm in North Macedonia reaches financial close.
